content.short: The Exiles is a Telegram game in the Shelter of Exiles universe with events, leaderboards, and reward driven progression.
content.description: The Exiles is the Telegram mini app entry point to the Shelter of Exiles game universe. It is presented as a social game layer where players join timed events, compete on leaderboards, complete reward campaigns, and build a presence inside the broader ecosystem. The wider project also connects this experience to token rewards, NFT assets, marketplace activity, and other game systems, so the mini app works as both a playable product and an onboarding path into the larger Shelter of Exiles universe.
content.meta: The Exiles connects Telegram players to events, leaderboards, and reward based progression inside the wider Shelter of Exiles ecosystem.
